policy: Fresh repository decoding of all 720 development first-party streams. Encoded and independent decoded hashes match the retained measured curves. This supplements their original pinned native and Rust validation.

value.policy: All six PureJsImage points for every frozen source. Verify encoded hashes, regenerate the pinned native oracle and require its pixel hash to match the scored raster. Repository RGB8 output must have identical dimensions and differ by at most 2 per sample. Missing, failed or changed artifacts fail verification. Each source runs serially in a fresh process; only one native reference bitmap is retained at a time.

policy.concurrency: One fixed user-service name admits only one complete benchmark tree at a time
